worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.summary: The plainest full-body tackle: charge in a straight line, hurl the target, then lean on it and settle in place, paying a moderate recoil. A whiff just skids to a stop.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.description: A straight-line charge that stops on the first target it hits: the tackle deals %1$s contact damage, charging up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius. A whiff or a blocked charge just skids to a stop with no self-damage.

On a hit the target is hurled %2$s blocks along the charge, the user takes %1$s× the actual damage as recoil, and leans on the target for %3$s s; while pressed the user cannot freely turn to chase, then settles in place. The user is no longer thrown back.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.brace.on: Braced form: put all the weight in, hurling the target further with a longer press, but taking heavier recoil and a slower wind-up and recovery.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.brace.off: Driving form: settle faster with lighter recoil, hurling the target a little less far.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.growth.0: From level %1$s the tackle power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.growth.1: From level %1$s the tackle power rises to %2$s and the recoil fraction to %3$s×.
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.use.1: Hurl a target off an ally or off a ledge
worldcombat.skill.doubleedge.use.2: Trade for a solid contact blow when survival is not in question
On: put all the weight in, hurling the target further with a longer press, but the tackle is a little weaker and shorter, it takes heavier recoil, and its wind-up and recovery are slower - good for shoving a target off an ally or a ledge. Off (driving form): settle faster with lighter recoil, hurling the target a little less far.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts tackles sooner, and is easier to whiff.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting tackles (it still charges in when the target is below about 35%% health). Higher is more protective, and grabs fewer kills.
